patch_description: Following the recommendation, modify `_ring_crz` so nearest-neighbor ring entanglement alternates rotation axis: even edges keep the shared `crz_ring_even` CRZ rotation, while odd edges switch to a shared `cry_ring_odd` CRY rotation. This adds axis diversity to the local entangling layer at zero extra gate/parameter cost (same gate count, same 2 shared parameters for the ring), which prior generations (Gen25/Gen38 style) showed increases expressivity of the entangling structure without added depth.
